scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @er/server" "npm run dev -w @er/web"
scripts.demo: npm run build -w @er/web && node apps/web/scripts/check-precache.mjs && concurrently -k -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run start -w @er/server" "npm run preview -w @er/web"
scripts.infra:diff: npm --prefix infra ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix infra run diff
scripts.infra:deploy: npm --prefix infra ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix infra run deploy
scripts.infra:destroy: npm --prefix infra ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix infra run destroy
